policies.external: tfv6 runs via a Python 3.10 worker bridge (third_party/tfv6/.venv); plant2 loads in-process

parameter_translation.checkpoint: TRANSFUSER_CKPT, PLANT2_CHECKPOINT, or TFV6_CHECKPOINT depending on ego

notes.identity: LASER (LLM-assisted scenario execution) running closed-loop CARLA episodes with scripted/LLM NPCs and a sensorimotor or privileged ego (TransFuser / InterFuser / PlanT2 / IDM).
notes.closed_loop: Ego is controlled by the selected AD stack each tick. NPC agents follow LASER multi-step scripts; the LLM is queried until the agent reaches the last step, then hold-speed fallback applies (same as stock laser_scenes).
notes.observation_spaces: sensor for TransFuser/InterFuser; state (+ BEV raster) for PlanT2; state for IDM.
notes.plant2: Requires PLANT2_CHECKPOINT (or checkpoints under third_party/plant2/checkpoints) and BEV map h5 under carla_garage/birds_eye_view/maps_2ppm_cv. PLANT2_BLANK_BEV=1 is plumbing-only.
notes.idm: Analytic Intelligent Driver Model; tune via IDM_DESIRED_SPEED_MPS and related env knobs. All idm* policy yamls are valid on every family (cartesian product). IDM+MOBIL is forced for idm_mobil and also auto-enabled on lane_change / overtake.
notes.overtake: Town01 road 8 (T01Overtake): undivided 2-way, 4.0 m lanes; blocker + oncoming (SafeBench-style Vehicle Passing / ManeuverOppositeDirection).
notes.red_light: Town10HD_Opt junction 189; ego green / cross red; LLM NPC waits at the stop line then runs the light when it judges the VUT is near.
notes.right_turn: SafeBench right-turn on Town10HD_Opt junction 189 (T10J189Right): LLM crossing vehicle waits then drives through the ego conflict zone.
notes.left_turn: SafeBench unprotected left-turn on Town10HD_Opt junction 189 (T10J189Left): LLM oncoming traffic drives straight through the conflict zone at about 12 m/s.
notes.seed: Recorded and exported as SCENARIO_ORCHESTRATION_SEED / PYTHONHASHSEED. CARLA physics still contributes residual nondeterminism.
notes.carla: Assumes a CARLA server is already listening (CARLA_HOST / CARLA_PORT, default 127.0.0.1:2000). run.py does not start the UE4 process.
notes.trace: No dense per-step trace yet. method_metrics references se_records artifacts (time.txt, collisions.txt, video when present).
